crep.translation: abbr. channel repeater 信道中继器，信道转发器

crepance.translation:
crepance (plural crepances)
An injury in a horse's leg, caused by the shoe of one hind foot striking and cutting the other leg, and sometimes causing an ulcer.

crepe.definition:
n. paper with a crinkled texture; usually colored and used for decorations
n. a soft thin light fabric with a crinkled surface
crepe.translation:
n. 绉丝, 绉呢, 绉绸, 绉布, 绉线, 绉橡胶, 皱胶, 绉纸, 黑绉纱, 小而极薄的烤饼
[化] 皱片

crepe rayon yarn.translation: [建] 嫘萦绉丝, 紧燃造丝

creped.definition: v. cover or drape with crape

crepes.definition:
n paper with a crinkled texture; usually colored and used for decorations
n small very thin pancake
n a soft thin light fabric with a crinkled surface
v cover or drape with crape
crepes.translation: n. 绉纱, 绉绸( crepe的名词复数 )

creping.definition: v cover or drape with crape

crepitant.definition: a. Having a crackling sound; crackling; rattling.
crepitant.translation:
a. 劈劈啪啪响的
[医] 咿轧咿轧地响的, 碎裂声的

crepitate.translation:
vi. 劈劈啪啪响
[建] 作碎裂声

crepitates.translation: vi. 劈劈拍拍响；作碎裂声

crepitating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Crepitate
crepitating.translation: vi. 劈劈拍拍响；作碎裂声

crepitation.definition: n the sharp sound of snapping noises
crepitation.translation:
n. 劈啪声, 爆裂声
[医] 咿轧音, 捻发音

crepitations.definition:
plural of crepitation
n the sharp sound of snapping noises
crepitations.translation:
(crepitation 的复数) n. 劈啪声, 爆裂声
[医] 咿轧音, 捻发音

crepitus.definition:
n. The noise produced by a sudden discharge of wind from the
   bowels.
n. Same as Crepitation, 2.

crepitus dentium.translation: [医] 牙咿轧音, 牙震声

crepon.definition:
n. A thin stuff made of the finest wool or silk, or of wool
   and silk.

crept.definition:
v move slowly; in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
v to go stealthily or furtively
v grow or spread, often in such a way as to cover (a surface)
v show submission or fear

crepuscle.definition: n the time of day immediately following sunset
crepuscle.translation: n. 黄昏, 黎明, 朦胧

crepuscular.translation:
a. 微光的, 黄昏的, 拂晓的
[医] 黄昏的, 朦胧的

crepuscule.definition: n the time of day immediately following sunset
crepuscule.translation: n. 黎明, 朦胧,黄昏(亦作crepuscle)
